parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "models/gemini-embedding-001", content: { parts: [{ text: $json.text }] }, taskType: "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT", title: $json.metadata.section }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO knowledge_chunks (text, metadata, embedding)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, $3::vector)
ON CONFLICT ((metadata->>'source'), (metadata->>'section'))
DO UPDATE SET text = EXCLUDED.text,
              metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
              embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding;
